Messages.Author: Bryan Nelson
Messages.Body:
Can I play bribes during a political action and gain a pool BEFORE
anyone announces intent to block?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Bryan Nelson wrote:
>
> Can I play bribes during a political action and gain a pool BEFORE
> anyone announces intent to block?

No. Cards (like Bribes) that say "only during a political action"
are normally referring to the referendum part of a political action.
